requirements.text: The web application must allow users to generate a password by interacting with the UI elements provided. Users can specify the password length using the input field with data-testid 'password-length-input', which accepts values between 4 and 20. Users can also select criteria for the password composition by checking or unchecking the checkboxes with data-testids 'include-uppercase-checkbox', 'include-lowercase-checkbox', 'include-numbers-checkbox', and 'include-symbols-checkbox'. Upon clicking the 'Generate Password' button with data-testid 'generate-password-button', the system should generate a password that adheres to the selected criteria and display it in the result area with data-testid 'result-display'. The generated password must match the specified length and include the selected character types. If no criteria are selected, the result area should remain empty, indicating that a password cannot be generated without any character type selection. Additionally, users can copy the generated password to the clipboard by clicking the button with data-testid 'copy-to-clipboard-button', which triggers a notification indicating successful copying.

The web application should provide a 'Copy to Clipboard' functionality for the generated password. When the user clicks the button with data-testid 'copy-to-clipboard-button', the system should check if a password is displayed in the element with data-testid 'result-display'. If a password is present, it should be copied to the clipboard, and a notification with the message 'Password copied to clipboard!' should appear on the screen for 3 seconds. If no password is present, the clipboard should remain unchanged, and no notification should be displayed.

The user must be able to specify the desired password length using the number input field with the attribute data-testid 'password-length-input'. The input field should accept values ranging from a minimum of 4 to a maximum of 20. Upon entering a valid length and clicking the 'Generate Password' button with data-testid 'generate-password-button', the application should generate and display a password in the result element with data-testid 'result-display' that matches the specified length. The system should handle edge cases where the minimum and maximum lengths are specified, ensuring the generated password adheres to these constraints.

The user must be able to toggle the inclusion of uppercase letters in the generated password by interacting with the 'Include uppercase letters' checkbox, identified by the attribute data-testid='include-uppercase-checkbox'. When the checkbox is checked, the generated password must include at least one uppercase letter. When the checkbox is unchecked, the generated password must exclude all uppercase letters. The state of the checkbox must persist until the user explicitly changes it, and the password generation logic must respect the current state of the checkbox at the time the 'Generate Password' button (data-testid='generate-password-button') is clicked. The generated password is displayed in the element with data-testid='result-display'. The system must handle multiple toggles of the checkbox before password generation, ensuring that the final state of the checkbox determines the inclusion or exclusion of uppercase letters in the password.

The user must be able to control the inclusion of lowercase letters in the generated password through the 'Include lowercase letters' checkbox, identified by the attribute data-testid='include-lowercase-checkbox'. When checked, the password generated upon clicking the 'Generate Password' button (data-testid='generate-password-button') should contain at least one lowercase letter. Conversely, when unchecked, the generated password should exclude all lowercase letters. The application should correctly handle multiple toggles of the checkbox before password generation, ensuring the final state of the checkbox accurately reflects the inclusion or exclusion of lowercase letters in the password displayed in the element with data-testid='result-display'.

The user must be able to toggle the inclusion of numbers in the generated password by interacting with the 'Include numbers' checkbox, identified by the attribute data-testid='include-numbers-checkbox'. When checked, the password generation process should ensure that at least one number is included in the password. Conversely, when unchecked, the password should exclude numbers entirely. The user can perform multiple toggles before generating the password, and the final state of the checkbox should dictate the presence or absence of numbers in the password. The password generation is initiated by clicking the 'Generate Password' button, identified by data-testid='generate-password-button', and the resulting password is displayed in the element with data-testid='result-display'.

The user must be able to toggle the inclusion of symbols in the generated password by interacting with the 'Include symbols' checkbox (data-testid: 'include-symbols-checkbox'). When the checkbox is checked, the generated password must include at least one symbol from the predefined set of symbols ('!@#$%^&*(){}[]=<>/,.') if the password length allows. When the checkbox is unchecked, the generated password must exclude all symbols. The system must handle edge cases where the checkbox is toggled multiple times before generating the password, ensuring the final state of the checkbox determines the inclusion or exclusion of symbols. If the 'Include symbols' checkbox is unchecked and no other character types (uppercase, lowercase, numbers) are selected, the result area (data-testid: 'result-display') must display an empty string. The password generation process is triggered by clicking the 'Generate Password' button (data-testid: 'generate-password-button'), and the generated password is displayed in the result area (data-testid: 'result-display').

generated_cases.title: Generate password with valid length and criteria selected
generated_cases.description: Verify that the system generates and displays a password matching the specified valid length (between 4 and 20) and adheres to the selected character criteria when clicking the 'Generate Password' button.

generated_cases.title: Generate password with no criteria selected
generated_cases.description: Verify that when no character criteria checkboxes are selected, the result area remains empty indicating that a password cannot be generated.

generated_cases.title: Copy generated password to clipboard when present
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'copy-to-clipboard-button' when a password is displayed in 'result-display' successfully copies it to the clipboard and triggers a notification for 3 seconds.

generated_cases.title: Attempt to copy to clipboard when no password is present
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'copy-to-clipboard-button' when no password is displayed leaves the clipboard unchanged and displays no notification.

generated_cases.title: Password generation with minimum valid length boundary
generated_cases.description: Verify that the application successfully generates and displays a password of exactly length 4 adhering to constraints.

generated_cases.title: Password generation with maximum valid length boundary
generated_cases.description: Verify that the application successfully generates and displays a password of exactly length 20 adhering to constraints.

generated_cases.title: Include and exclude uppercase letters with multiple toggles
generated_cases.description: Verify that toggling the 'include-uppercase-checkbox' multiple times correctly determines the inclusion or exclusion of uppercase letters in the final generated password based on its final state.

generated_cases.title: Include and exclude lowercase letters with multiple toggles
generated_cases.description: Verify that toggling the 'include-lowercase-checkbox' multiple times correctly determines the inclusion or exclusion of lowercase letters in the final generated password based on its final state.

generated_cases.title: Include and exclude numbers with multiple toggles
generated_cases.description: Verify that toggling the 'include-numbers-checkbox' multiple times correctly determines the presence or absence of numbers in the final generated password based on its final state.

generated_cases.title: Include and exclude symbols with multiple toggles
generated_cases.description: Verify that toggling the 'include-symbols-checkbox' multiple times correctly determines the inclusion or exclusion of symbols in the final generated password based on its final state.

generated_cases.title: Password Length Below Minimum (3)
generated_cases.description: Verify that setting the password length input (data-testid 'password-length-input') to 3 (just below the minimum boundary of 4) is handled correctly by the application.

generated_cases.title: Password Length at Minimum (4)
generated_cases.description: Verify that setting the password length input (data-testid 'password-length-input') to 4 (the minimum boundary) successfully generates a password of length 4.

generated_cases.title: Password Length Just Above Minimum (5)
generated_cases.description: Verify that setting the password length input (data-testid 'password-length-input') to 5 (just within the valid range above the minimum boundary) successfully generates a password of length 5.

generated_cases.title: Password Length Just Below Maximum (19)
generated_cases.description: Verify that setting the password length input (data-testid 'password-length-input') to 19 (just within the valid range below the maximum boundary) successfully generates a password of length 19.

generated_cases.title: Password Length at Maximum (20)
generated_cases.description: Verify that setting the password length input (data-testid 'password-length-input') to 20 (the maximum boundary) successfully generates a password of length 20.

generated_cases.title: Password Length Above Maximum (21)
generated_cases.description: Verify that setting the password length input (data-testid 'password-length-input') to 21 (just outside the maximum boundary of 20) is handled correctly by the application.

generated_cases.title: Transition from Initial Empty State to Password Generated State with Valid Criteria
generated_cases.description: Verify that when the application is in the initial empty state, entering a valid length (e.g., 10), selecting at least one criteria checkbox, and clicking the generate password button successfully transitions the system to the password generated state and displays the password.

generated_cases.title: Transition from Initial State to Empty Result State with No Criteria Selected
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the generate password button while no criteria checkboxes are selected keeps the result display in an empty state.

generated_cases.title: Transition from Password Generated State to Clipboard Copied State
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the copy-to-clipboard button when a password is displayed in the result area successfully copies the password and triggers the notification for 3 seconds.

generated_cases.title: Forbidden Transition: Copy to Clipboard from Empty Result State
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the copy-to-clipboard button when no password is present in the result display does not change the clipboard and does not trigger any notification.

generated_cases.title: State Transition Handling Multiple Checkbox Toggles Before Generation
generated_cases.description: Verify that toggling criteria checkboxes multiple times correctly maintains the final state of each checkbox (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols) and generates a password matching those final states.

generated_cases.title: State Transition with Edge Case Password Lengths
generated_cases.description: Verify that generating a password with minimum length (4) and maximum length (20) successfully transitions the state and produces a password adhering to the length constraints.

generated_cases.title: Generate password with valid length and all criteria selected
generated_cases.description: Verify that a password is successfully generated adhering to the specified length (between 4 and 20) and including all selected character types (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols).

generated_cases.title: Attempt to generate password with no criteria selected
generated_cases.description: Verify that when no character criteria checkboxes are selected, the result area remains empty and no password is generated.

generated_cases.title: Copy generated password to clipboard successfully
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the copy button when a password is present in the result display copies it to the clipboard and shows a success notification for 3 seconds.

generated_cases.title: Attempt to copy when no password is present
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the copy button when the result area is empty leaves the clipboard unchanged and displays no notification.

generated_cases.title: Generate password with minimum length and all criteria checked
generated_cases.description: Set password length to 4 using 'password-length-input', check uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols checkboxes, and click 'generate-password-button'. Verify the generated password is displayed in 'result-display', has a length of 4, and contains at least one character from each selected category.

generated_cases.title: Generate password with maximum length and single criteria checked
generated_cases.description: Set password length to 20 using 'password-length-input', check only the uppercase checkbox while keeping lowercase, numbers, and symbols unchecked, and click 'generate-password-button'. Verify the generated password contains only uppercase letters and has a length of 20.

generated_cases.title: Generate password with no criteria selected resulting in empty display
generated_cases.description: Set password length to a valid value, ensure all checkboxes (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols) are unchecked, and click 'generate-password-button'. Verify that 'result-display' remains empty.

generated_cases.title: Copy generated password to clipboard with active result
generated_cases.description: Generate a valid password so that 'result-display' is populated, then click 'copy-to-clipboard-button'. Verify that the password is copied and a notification message 'Password copied to clipboard!' appears for 3 seconds.

generated_cases.title: Attempt to copy when result area is empty
generated_cases.description: Ensure 'result-display' is empty (e.g., no criteria selected or cleared state), then click 'copy-to-clipboard-button'. Verify the clipboard remains unchanged and no notification is displayed.

generated_cases.title: Toggle checkboxes multiple times before generating password
generated_cases.description: Perform multiple toggles on uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols checkboxes to test state persistence, settle on a specific combination, set a valid length, and click 'generate-password-button'. Verify that the final state correctly dictates the inclusion and exclusion of character types in 'result-display'.

generated_cases.title: Successful Password Generation with All Criteria and Valid Length
generated_cases.description: User sets valid length (e.g., 12), selects uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols checkboxes, and clicks the generate password button. The result area displays a password matching the length and criteria.

generated_cases.title: Password Generation with No Criteria Selected
generated_cases.description: User leaves all checkboxes unchecked, specifies a valid length, and clicks the generate password button. The result area remains empty indicating no password can be generated.

generated_cases.title: Copy Generated Password to Clipboard Successfully
generated_cases.description: User generates a password, which is displayed in the result area, and clicks the copy-to-clipboard button. The password is copied to the clipboard and a success notification appears for 3 seconds.

generated_cases.title: Attempt to Copy When No Password is Present
generated_cases.description: User clicks the copy-to-clipboard button while the result display is empty. The clipboard remains unchanged and no notification is displayed.

generated_cases.title: Edge Cases for Password Length Bounds
generated_cases.description: User sets password length to minimum (4) and maximum (20) limits respectively, selects criteria, and clicks generate. The resulting passwords adhere strictly to the specified boundary lengths.

generated_cases.title: Toggle Checkboxes Multiple Times Before Generation
generated_cases.description: User toggles uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols checkboxes multiple times to verify that the final states dictate the inclusion or exclusion of the respective character types in the generated password.

generated_cases.title: Generate password with length below minimum boundary
generated_cases.description: Attempt to generate a password by entering a length less than 4 (e.g., 3) in the 'password-length-input' field to check boundary failure handling.

generated_cases.title: Generate password with length above maximum boundary
generated_cases.description: Attempt to generate a password by entering a length greater than 20 (e.g., 21) in the 'password-length-input' field to verify upper boundary error handling.

generated_cases.title: Generate password with all criteria checkboxes unchecked
generated_cases.description: Click 'Generate Password' when all composition checkboxes (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols) are unchecked, ensuring the result area remains empty.

generated_cases.title: Copy to clipboard when result area is empty
generated_cases.description: Click the 'copy-to-clipboard-button' when no password is generated or displayed in the 'result-display' element, ensuring no clipboard change and no notification appear.

generated_cases.title: Rapid multiple toggles of checkboxes before generation
generated_cases.description: Toggle uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol checkboxes multiple times rapidly and generate password to ensure the final states correctly dictate the inclusion and exclusion of characters.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Generate password with default settings
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Password Generation

  Scenario: [Normal] Generate password with default settings
    Given the webpage is loaded with the password generator
    And the password length input with data-testid "password-length-input" is set to "20"
    And the include uppercase checkbox with data-testid "include-uppercase-checkbox" is checked
    And the include lowercase checkbox with data-testid "include-lowercase-checkbox" is checked
    And the include numbers checkbox with data-testid "include-numbers-checkbox" is checked
    And the include symbols checkbox with data-testid "include-symbols-checkbox" is checked
    When the user clicks the generate password button with data-testid "generate-password-button"
    Then a password is displayed in the result area with data-testid "result-display"
    And the password length is "20"
    And the password includes uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols
